hooks.command: f=$(perl -ne 'print "$1" if /"file_path"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/'); t="/tmp/__pmpm_hk.$$"; jschk(){ if command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1; then osascript -l JavaScript -e 'function run(a){ObjC.import("Foundation");var s=$.NSString.stringWithContentsOfFileEncodingError(a[0],$.NSUTF8StringEncoding,null);try{new Function(s.js);return "OK"}catch(e){return "FAIL: "+e.message}}' "$1"; elif command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node --check "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo OK || { printf 'FAIL: '; node --check "$1" 2>&1 | head -1; }; else echo SKIP; fi; }; case "$f" in *Screen_*.html) perl -0777 -ne 'while(/<script\b([^>]*)>(.*?)<\/script>/gis){next if $1=~/\bsrc\s*=/i; next if $2=~/^\s*$/; print $2,"\0"}' "$f" | while IFS= read -r -d '' body; do printf '%s' "$body" > "$t.js"; r=$(jschk "$t.js"); case "$r" in OK) ;; SKIP) echo "⚠ syntax gate SKIPPED in $f: no JS parser (osascript/node) on this machine" ;; *) echo "SYNTAX GATE FAIL in $f: $r" ;; esac; done; rm -f "$t.js" ;; *PRD_*.html) if command -v xmllint >/dev/null 2>&1; then xmllint --noout "$f" 2>"$t.err" || echo "SVG/XML not well-formed in $f: $(head -1 "$t.err")"; rm -f "$t.err"; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -c 'import sys,xml.dom.minidom as m; m.parse(sys.argv[1])' "$f" 2>"$t.err" || echo "SVG/XML not well-formed in $f: $(head -1 "$t.err")"; rm -f "$t.err"; fi; n=$(perl -0777 -pe 's{<defs\b.*?</defs>}{}gis' "$f" | grep -coE '<(rect|circle|line|path|text|polygon|polyline|ellipse|image|use)\b'); [ "$n" = "0" ] && echo "SVG WARNING in $f: 0 shapes outside <defs> — diagram may be blank" ;; esac; exit 0
